scope: GTK TSV clipboard payload pasted into LibreOffice Calc
procedure: Publish the TSV text below on the X11 clipboard using UTF8_STRING.
Open a blank Calc sheet, select A1, paste with Ctrl+V, and accept the Text Import dialog defaults.
Read A1:A8 through the LibreOffice UNO API; retained cells and types are in calc-cell-results.json.
assertions: Literal NULL, SQL NULL marker \NNN, and marker-shaped text \N and \NN remain distinct after paste.
Quoted empty text imports as an empty Calc cell; the explicit SQL NULL marker remains non-empty.
Formula-shaped text is stored as text and does not become a formula.
Quoted embedded tab, newline, and double quote remain in one text cell.
remaining: This validates the TSV clipboard flavor in LibreOffice Calc only; other spreadsheet applications and the broader typed consumer matrix remain open.
